change: Existing crop acceleration button now requests rewarded AdMob video instead of charging one gem.
reward_rule: Only the SDK earned-reward event can finish the captured crop. No instant/free fallback when unsupported, offline or disabled.
guards: exact plot identity, crop, planting time and generation
no gem bonus attached to speedup
controls do not overlap action panel

android_configuration.note: Uses existing Firebase Remote Config and AdMob consent/init flow; flags remain remotely controlled.

device_limitation: Real ad delivery has not been tested on an Android device. PC requests report that rewarded ads are Android-only and never simulate a reward.
